notes.title: SECOND SCORING CONTEST
notes.notes:
[p]It's time for a second score contest ! 
The grand prize will be a free commission from me

The contest will end on june 20th, in one week

Rules :
-runs must be on the steam demo
-take a screenshot of the whole screen at the end of your run, in front of the final staircase
-only one submission per person -make it count !
-sharing strategies with other players is encouraged !
-more information is available on the discord, as well as strategy discussion and such

[url="https://discord.gg/g7nkRKery8?event=1382977057507643536"]https://discord.gg/g7nkRKery8?event=1382977057507643536[/url][/p]
